title: 情報工学特別講義Ⅱ
subtitle: Special Lecture for Information and Computer Science 2
teachers:
ABE Noriyuki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
“Fundamental Information Technology Engineer Examination (FE)” is known as the gateway to success for new ICT engineers. The FE is divided into the first half and the second half on the test day, and it is necessary to pass both of the examinations at the same day.
Students will learn the basic ICT skills to pass the first half of the FE exam.
advice:
This is a basic countermeasure course to pass the first half of the FE exam. We will cover the following materials:
1. Computer basics
2. Radix conversion and complement
3. Computer components
4. Basic theory of computers
5. OS and middleware
6. System components
7. Multimedia technologies
8. Information Networks
9. Database systems
Students are expected to bring their textbook and other necessary materials to every class.
Students are expected to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class and on a regular basis.

              “Fundamental Information Technology Engineer Examination (FE)” is known as the gateway to success for new ICT engineers. The FE is divided into the first half and the second half on the test day, and it is necessary to pass both of the examinations at the same day.
Students will learn the basic ICT skills to pass the first half of the FE exam.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is a basic countermeasure course to pass the first half of the FE exam. We will cover the following materials:
1. Computer basics
2. Radix conversion and complement
3. Computer components
4. Basic theory of computers
5. OS and middleware
6. System components
7. Multimedia technologies
8. Information Networks
9. Database systems
Students are expected to bring their textbook and other necessary materials to every class.
Students are expected to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class and on a regular basis.
